99.note: Task recovery guidance never invokes removed get: an established safe leaf can offer task_doc.replace with the exact slug, contract and fields, while an unknown leaf or parent path offers file repair without a guessed mutation. Launch copies contain the own leaf plus declared local requirements, name missing sources without failing launch solely for absence, and refresh/reclaim on canonical publication under the existing rollback and copy budgets. Status copy drift is informational; missing notice is not universal byte equality. Packet-owned refusal presentation preserves the central conversion sentence and single probe-made case, with exact sync args or quoted separate first-conversion argv and no step for unknown. These accounts change neither canonical-file authority, checkpoint/pause distinction, cleanup/reclamation eligibility, paired source lineage nor sync behavior.
